items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Now, I missed Louis Armstrong by about two weeks. I tried to get him to go to Europe with me.

ctx.x: Yeah. But they wasn't nothing. And a lot of people get this thing about -- that jazz originated in -- which is very simple and very elementary to say that jazz originated in New Orleans, because it didn't. It spontaneously originated all over the United States. New Orleans contributed so much to it. But even Louis Armstrong still wouldn't have been anything if it don't be for him coming to New York with Fletcher Henderson. Because Fletcher Henderson gave him the showcase. But nobody -- they mention Louis…
Now, I missed Louis Armstrong by about two weeks. I tried to get him to go to Europe with me.
We'll get to that later. Because, right now, we're still in 1920 or '21.
